name: Tempester 1.6.5.0 — rolls, channels and long notes
summary: Everything in 1.6.4.0, plus a MIDI channel and a settings page per pad, notes as long as an 8-bar beat, finer Quantize, Copy Sound with its sequence, a swinging roll and six fixes.

fixes: After a beat change the Reverse LED shows whether the pads play reversed now.
Pads + Sounds (« Mixer ») opens the Mixer after the compressor pages, instead of reopening them.
In 16 Time Steps a pad lights for every note of its step, and a press on a lit pad removes those notes.
With the sequencer stopped, Roll and arpeggio repeats fall on the beat's grid; the Momentary Roll footswitch turns Roll on while pressed and off when released.
A playing beat roll no longer loses the notes recorded late in its window.
The compressor envelope Amount goes down to −127 as shown, on the knob and in a loaded beat.
additions: Each pad can send its notes on its own MIDI channel, with its played note or a fixed drum note (set over MIDI with CC 15-17 or on the pad settings page, kept in the System settings).
Shift + pad selects a pad without playing it in every mode; a second press opens the pad's settings page: MIDI note, MIDI channel, play probability and Level.
Notes can last up to 768 steps of 4 ticks, a whole 8-bar beat (255 before), recorded or edited.
More Quantize values for recording: dotted, 64th, quintuplets and septuplets.
Edit > Copy Sound can copy the sound's sequence, Note FX and mixer settings to another beat.
System > Swing Source « +Roll »: the beat roll follows the swing.
changes: In 16 Beats and 16 Time Steps, Shift + pad now selects the pad's sound (silently) instead of a beat or a step.

description: 1.6.4.0 plus n°48-n°56, n°58, n°59 and n°61, each proved on the test builds 1.6.5.0-f (n°48-n°51), -g (n°52, n°53), -h (n°54, n°61), -i (n°55, n°56) and -j (n°58, n°59), and together on this image. n°52 was kept after the author's listening test. n°37's recipe is the 1.6.5.0 copy patch/dead_code_reclaim_1650.json (the range n°58 and n°59 use is left out of it). Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
